summaryZh: Toor Lab 研究 RNA 结构与生物学的关系，并探索用于治疗的 RNA 化学修饰。方法包括冷冻电镜、单分子荧光和有机化学。

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Toor Lab! We investigate the relationship between RNA structure and biology. We use tools ranging from cryo-EM to single-molecule fluorescence. In addition, we also use organic chemistry to expand the universe of chemical modifications that can be added to RNA for therapeutics.
